  # aws_ssm_document.aws_ssm_document_document_536 will be imported
    resource "aws_ssm_document" "aws_ssm_document_document_536" {
        arn              = "arn:aws:ssm:ap-southeast-1:396913734272:document/AAP-Component-CreateUser-InstallSSHKey"
        content          = jsonencode(
            {
                description   = "Create aapuser and install public key from Parameter Store "
                mainSteps     = [
                    {
                        action = "aws:runShellScript"
                        inputs = {
                            runCommand     = [
                                "#!/bin/bash",
                                "set -euo pipefail",
                                "LOG=/var/log/aap-create-user-sshkey.log",
                                "exec > >(tee -a \"$LOG\" | logger -t ssm-aap-ssh -s 2>/dev/console) 2>&1",
                                "echo \"[INFO] Starting user/key setup at $(date -Is)\"",
                                "# Parameters from SSM Run Command",
                                "USERNAME='{{ Username }}'",
                                "GROUPNAME='{{ GroupName }}'",
                                "INSTALLER_PUBKEY='{{ InstallerPublicKey }}'",
                                "# Basic sanity",
                                "if [[ -z \"$INSTALLER_PUBKEY\" ]]; then",
                                "  echo \"[ERROR] InstallerPublicKey is empty. Check Parameter Store value or override the parameter.\"",
                                "  exit 1",
                                "fi",
                                "echo \"[INFO] Ensuring group: $GROUPNAME\"",
                                "getent group \"$GROUPNAME\" >/dev/null || groupadd \"$GROUPNAME\"",
                                "echo \"[INFO] Ensuring user: $USERNAME\"",
                                "if ! id -u \"$USERNAME\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then",
                                "  useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash -g \"$GROUPNAME\" \"$USERNAME\"",
                                "fi",
                                "SSH_DIR=\"/home/$USERNAME/.ssh\"",
                                "AUTH_KEYS=\"$SSH_DIR/authorized_keys\"",
                                "mkdir -p \"$SSH_DIR\"",
                                "touch \"$AUTH_KEYS\"",
                                "# Append key only if not present (idempotent)",
                                "if ! grep -qxF \"$INSTALLER_PUBKEY\" \"$AUTH_KEYS\"; then",
                                "  echo \"$INSTALLER_PUBKEY\" >> \"$AUTH_KEYS\"",
                                "  echo \"[INFO] Public key appended to $AUTH_KEYS\"",
                                "else",
                                "  echo \"[INFO] Public key already present in $AUTH_KEYS\"",
                                "fi",
                                "# De-dup and lock down",
                                "sort -u \"$AUTH_KEYS\" -o \"$AUTH_KEYS\"",
                                "chown -R \"$USERNAME:$GROUPNAME\" \"$SSH_DIR\"",
                                "chmod 700 \"$SSH_DIR\"",
                                "chmod 600 \"$AUTH_KEYS\"",
                                "# Passwordless sudo for this user",
                                "SUDO_FILE=\"/etc/sudoers.d/${USERNAME}\"",
                                "echo \"$USERNAME ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL\" > \"$SUDO_FILE\"",
                                "chmod 440 \"$SUDO_FILE\"",
                                "# SELinux contexts (RHEL/Enforcing)",
                                "if command -v restorecon >/dev/null 2>&1; then",
                                "  restorecon -Rv \"$SSH_DIR\" \"$SUDO_FILE\" || true",
                                "fi",
                                "# Ensure sshd running",
                                "systemctl enable --now sshd || true",
                                "echo \"[INFO] Completed user/key setup at $(date -Is)\"",
                            ]
                            timeoutSeconds = 600
                        }
                        name   = "CreateUserAndInstallKey"
                    },
                ]
                parameters    = {
                    GroupName          = {
                        default     = "{{ssm:/aap/ec2/component-group}}"
                        description = "Primary group name"
                        type        = "String"
                    }
                    InstallerPublicKey = {
                        default     = "{{ssm:/aap/ec2/ssh-key}}"
                        description = "Installer's SSH public key (resolved from SSM Parameter Store by default)"
                        type        = "String"
                    }
                    Username           = {
                        default     = "{{ssm:/aap/ec2/component-username}}"
                        description = "Target username to create/configure"
                        type        = "String"
                    }
                }
                schemaVersion = "2.2"
            }
        )
        created_date     = "2025-10-08T08:52:41Z"
